title: Observer-Based State Feedback Controller for a Mindlin Plate Model in port-Hamiltonian framework
summary: This paper generalises an early lumped observer-based state-feedback (OBSF) control design methodology, originally developed for one-dimensional (1-D) boundary-controlled port-Hamiltonian systems, to a two-dimensional (2-D) boundary-controlled Mindlin plate. To this end, the 2-D port-Hamiltonian Mindlin plate model is first introduced and then discretized using a structure-preserving finite-difference method on staggered grids.
